author: Tavmania
body:
> with my bluetooth mouse  

I just have to make sure - you're playing on a phone right? Not on an emulator? It's not crazy to get banned for using Nox purely because of its innate ability to spoof locations.  

In like 99% of all cases, there is most definitely a reason that your account was detected for "botting". Maybe the sheer presence of an autoclicker on your phone is enough?  

The fact that you have playtimes exceed 17 hours/day is a rather intriguing finding. The only explanation I can think of, is that you had the game running on an emulator and never bothered to turn the app off. This isn't the type of behavior that would happen on a phone (unless you're looking for a new phone, by purposefully melting the battery off your old phone).

author: ElZane87
body:
Aww dammit, that sucks Yggdrasil =(  
Since I know you from discord as always helpful and nice guy, that really is super sad to hear. Ofc, I am totally biased since I like you but I hope it can be resolved and actually believe you.  


About things that can cause ban, I just know that VPN usage actually can get you flagged. Not happened to me but it did happen to others and that was the reported cause here. The Bluetooth mouse should not actually be an issue, I think, but if the game detected you to play for 17 hours, and I doubt that this is wrong, I have to ask....  


Did you share your account details with someone else? Anyone? Brother, other family member, maybe just installed on another device and someone was playing without your knowledge? =/

author: reverandmaniac
body: I always play on my phone but at times my gps I use for verifying my location for work makes the game move me all over even though I'm stationary. It seems far more accurate when I'm moving. I also started setting my phone up recently to triangulate off of nearby wifi nodes even if not actively using the network. This has helped but i still get crazy drift at times. A few times it's taken me 12k kilometers away others just randomly within a few miles of home. Like i said insane gps drift. Also depending on what I'm actually doing at work sometimes i might get 12 to 16 hours a day in. I hope the bots tracking spoofing has a way to detect GPS drift and doesnt just auto ban

author: marr
body:
> "Hey there, Thanks for reaching out! I've reviewed your account and do see a suspicious amount of flags by the bot detection, along with playtimes exceeding 17 hours/day. Cheers."

Okay, yikes.  If that's the actual tone of response the developer puts out, that seems horribly cavalier and dismissive.  I get that he probably fields a hundred lies a day from hackers that were rightfully flagged, but it doesn't cost anything to have polite form responses on copy paste.  False positives exist and will include some of your most vulnerable players using accessibility tools.

Annnd the community here apparently think it's an acceptable professional response.  Also yikes.
